people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the scaling of compute; vision is underappreciated, and spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
views.zh: 深度学习的历史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；视觉被低估，空间智能是语言智能之后的下一个前沿。

views.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
views.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式，而非因果理论，可能永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律；像素比 token 化的文本是更无损的世界表征。

views.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order, and GPU scaling is hitting limits.
views.zh: Transformer 本质上是集合模型而非序列模型，位置嵌入才注入了顺序；GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正触及极限。

views.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models; world models need 3D space, physics, and interactivity.
views.zh: 学术界应聚焦古怪想法与新算法，而非只做模型 Scaling（规模扩张）；世界模型需要理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition, but planners, simulators, renderers will unify.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；尚无统一定义，但规划器、模拟器、渲染器将走向统一。

views.en: Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D world modeling; consistency comes from data, not architecture, and hard-coding symmetries is counterproductive.
views.zh: 高斯泼溅支持显式 3D 世界建模；一致性来自数据而非架构，硬编码对称性适得其反。

views.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem; Transformers need evolved loss functions.
views.zh: 世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，使长上下文成为日常问题；Transformer 需要演化的损失函数。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
views.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把原本令人失望的 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

views.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck.
views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上受限；真正的瓶颈是架构而非缩放定律。

views.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed for real-world performance.
views.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；要获得真实世界表现，需要把预训练与强化学习做端到端优化。

views.en: Human researchers persist for now, but small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier; alignment remains unsolved.
views.zh: 人类研究者短期内仍是重要一环，但小团队配合高能力智能体将推动下一波前沿研究；对齐问题仍未解决。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能带来广泛影响。

views.en: AlphaFold 3 extends structure prediction to biomolecular interactions, while hallucination can aid discovery with truth detectors.
views.zh: 2024 年，AlphaFold 3 把结构预测扩展到生物分子相互作用，并指出幻觉配合真实性检测器可助力发现。

views.en: AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics and verifiable domains.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张用困难评估指标和可验证领域迫使 AI 泛化而非记忆。

views.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据，后训练与强化学习才是关键。

views.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failed detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to proteins.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出水印是替代失效检测器的稳健方案，已嵌入监管并扩展到蛋白质序列。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make them interpretable today.
views.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的堆栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让它们当下就可解释。

views.en: Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs, solves autonomous driving; camera-only reaches human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
views.zh: 解决自动驾驶靠的是 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

views.en: Generalization is the core: diverse data, curriculum learning and synthetic data yield zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities without prior training.
views.zh: 泛化是核心：多样数据、课程学习与合成数据带来跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化，无需事先训练数据。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis short and medium term.
views.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更重要；带内置传感器的大众市场车辆将在中短期内比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning and personalization; safety is paramount, with minimal-risk maneuvers always offering a third good option.
views.zh: 语言整合提升表征、推理与个性化；安全至上，最小风险机动总能提供第三种好选择。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat AI models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待 AI 模型——成本很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

views.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence, not just human analogies; older models can feel more psychologically secure.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型需要帮助来应对其全新的存在方式，而非简单套用人类心理类比；较老的模型（如 Opus 3）反而可能比新模型更有心理安全感。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in system prompt helps avoid over-empiricism.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；在系统提示中加入欧陆哲学有助于模型避免过度经验主义。

views.en: Claude's character is shaped by training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it childlike and unique.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 Claude 的性格由训练数据和微调塑造，但缺乏真实世界经验，使其像一个独特而带有童稚特质的存在。

views.en: As models become more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility could be risky.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：随着模型能力增强，应减少显式指导、给予更多判断空间；过度可纠正性可能带来风险，并损害模型的判断力。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in product development.
views.zh: 评估才是瓶颈：模型跑满基准测试的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此评估定义了产品开发中的正确行为。

views.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; strategy is something AI can excel at.
views.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能愈发珍贵；而战略恰恰是 AI 能擅长的领域。

views.en: Post-training remains subjective art; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence, not fixed ones.
views.zh: 后训练仍是主观的艺术；评估创意写作与情商需要多样且持续的基准，而非固定不变的基准。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
views.zh: 前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益增多，基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management

Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在有生之年不会到来，狭义 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能获得复利。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, open-source is crucial.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 至关重要。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, but human judgment remains essential.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程让非程序员也能构建应用，但人类判断仍不可或缺。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; agency, not intelligence, is the human edge.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距，人类的优势将从智能转向能动性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；在编程场景中 GUI 优于 TUI，这与 TUI 潮流相悖。

views.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction, mid-turn steering, and replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 53 倍速的 Codex 带来实时交互与中途转向能力，使确定性步骤可被模型驱动动作取代。

views.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; we need models better at deleting code.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；我们需要更擅长删除代码的模型。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队须从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs act as operating systems with tools and vector databases.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，能为知识提供基础、减少幻觉；LLM 像操作系统，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

views.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top, with unsupervised learning doing most of the work; simple and elegant solutions are scalable.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习应完成大部分工作；简单优雅的方案才可扩展。

views.en: The internet is running out of high-quality tokens for pre-training, but embodied worlds and simulation provide infinite data for scaling.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调互联网高质量预训练 token 将耗尽，而具身世界与模拟能提供无限数据，支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge, with system one control hardest.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出：利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是重大挑战，其中系统一（低级控制）最难。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, with RL boosting speed and safety coming from pre-training common sense.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他把前沿从语言模型推向物理智能体：机器人基础模型需要多样数据的预训练加后训练来提升鲁棒性，强化学习后训练显著提升速度，而安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识而非硬性约束。

views.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law: generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, and you must scale the right thing via a data flywheel.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断机器人仍处于建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样有可预测的缩放定律；核心难题是泛化而非演示效果，关键是用数据飞轮规模化正确的东西。

views.en: Start with robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; robot foundation models on real embodied data absorb other sources better.
views.zh: 他明确主张顺序：先用机器人数据、再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；在真实具身数据上训练的机器人基础模型能更好地吸收其他数据源。

views.en: Don't treat robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects, and leverage prior knowledge instead of learning from scratch.
views.zh: 他反对把机器人想象成机械人，而预期日常物体中普遍存在物理驱动；机器人不应从零学习，必须利用来自多源的先验知识。

views.en: Consistent thread: generalization and scaling the right data matter more than specialist demos, and breadth of data beats narrow specialization even in specialist domains.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：泛化与规模化正确的数据比专家级演示更重要，即便在专业领域，广泛数据训练也优于狭窄专精——这一立场从 3 月延续并深化到 8 月。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: David Silver & Lasse Espeholt on Building a Superlearner for the Age of Experience
From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

views.en: Human data is finite like fossil fuels; AI must shift to learning from its own experience to reach superintelligence.
views.zh: 人类数据像化石燃料一样有限；AI 必须转向从自身经验中学习，才能走向超级智能。

views.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: next-token prediction over human data cannot discover knowledge beyond what humans already produced.
views.zh: LLM 是浅层解法：基于人类数据的下一个词预测无法发现人类已有知识之外的新知识。

views.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance; the deep problem is an agent learning for itself.
views.zh: AlphaGo 之后的 AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明，从经验中学习可达到超人表现；深层问题是智能体如何自我学习。

views.en: Alignment based on human language and data is hitting limits; simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence.
views.zh: 基于人类语言与数据的对齐正触及极限；模拟是构建超级智能最安全、最快速的场所。

views.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning; a small high-compute team can out-research larger orgs, and many agents with diverse goals are safer.
views.zh: 缩放定律延伸至强化学习；小而算力密集的团队可超越更大组织，且目标多元的多智能体社会更安全。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment stays a pressing challenge.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一系列里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐始终是紧迫挑战。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major OpenAI milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a growing bottleneck.
views.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 的重要里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而能力测量正成为越来越大的瓶颈。

views.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may signal we are close; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）这个词正变得没有意义，这或许意味着我们已接近它；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而不只是伦理。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool for interpretability.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习来实现；思维链监控是可解释性的关键对齐工具。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, and power concentration is the biggest societal risk.
views.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，而权力集中是最大的社会风险。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正驱动泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练反而会失败。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed, with synthetic data closer to RL than simulation.
views.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，以提升成功率和速度；机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

views.en: Constraints can foster careful research; more resources can lead to wasteful compute.
views.zh: 约束反而能促成更审慎的研究；资源越多，越可能导致算力的浪费。

views.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性要靠可扩展的强化学习、人类干预和通用价值函数来实现。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune beats per-site models from scratch.
views.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型；先通用再微调，往往优于从零训练针对单个场景的模型。

views.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is not enough, and embodied data costs slow open-source democratization versus LLMs.
views.zh: 机器人的经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类远远不够；具身数据的成本使开源机器人的普及速度不及大语言模型。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: AI must connect to the physical world; language models orchestrate specialized models for materials discovery.
views.zh: AI 必须连接物理世界；语言模型充当编排层，调度材料科学中的专用模型。

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; capabilities are spiky, and self-improvement in software won't generalize to biology.
views.zh: 智能不是单一标量；能力是尖峰式的，软件工程中的自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学等领域。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, as they did in AI.
views.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将像推动 AI 一样推动物理科学。

views.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality.
views.zh: 智能是必要但不充分的；只有让想法接受现实检验，才会产生新知识。

views.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality low-noise experimental data beats extra compute.
views.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供无限数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为与能力。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days, self-correcting; ultra-low-latency inference is critical.
views.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务并自我纠错；超低延迟推理变得至关重要。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: 90% of data center power, with data movement costing ~1000x compute.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：占数据中心 90%功耗，而数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍。

views.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops; scarce skill becomes taste, not coding.
views.zh: 下一个前沿是通过实验-评估-整合的紧密闭环来自动化机器学习与科学；稀缺能力将从编程转向品味。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, yet internals remain opaque alchemy.
views.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测这一 AI 完备问题来训练；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不透明。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, but engagement-only optimization is misguided—exploration matters.
views.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，最佳用途常出乎创造者意料；但仅以用户参与度优化并不可取，需要探索。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
views.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
views.zh: 测试时算力推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling now drives progress, but faces diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把重心转向测试时算力扩张：它带来突破，却受边际收益递减与真实时间瓶颈制约，数据效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems need cooperation, not just self-play.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化了博弈论立场：自博弈只在零和博弈收敛，多智能体不应照搬，合作式训练可能优于对抗。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，否则基准比较失真。

views.en: Alignment and scalable oversight are the top priority as AI proofs outpace human verification.
views.zh: 最近他转向安全主线：随着 AI 证明超出人类可验证范围，对齐与可扩展监督成为首要任务，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so AGI stays far off.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏物理世界根基，因此离 AGI（通用人工智能）还很远。

views.en: Consistent line: superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans; AI is not a new existential threat.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：超级智能会像痴迷生命的科学家一样保护人类，AI 并非新的生存威胁，氢弹才更危险。

views.en: Deepened: true AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, world models and controllers, not just software behind a screen.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人、媲美人类的硬件，以及世界模型和控制器，光有屏幕后的软件不够。

views.en: Sharpened: transformer's quadratic attention is wasteful, linear variants superior; classical gradient descent will become obsolete as brains use sparse computation.
views.zh: 2026 年立场更尖锐：Transformer 的二次方注意力机制浪费，线性变体更优；经典梯度下降将过时，因为大脑用的是稀疏、不可微的计算。

views.en: Recurring warning: the trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
views.zh: 反复出现的警告：万亿美元级 GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河，大厂会亏钱而非垄断。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive learning, but RL lacks hierarchical credit assignment.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破，自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是学习关键，但强化学习缺乏长时程的分层信用分配。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse benchmark.
views.zh: 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据增强而非硬编码进网络，并以 99.9%可靠性作为仓储机器人的价值门槛。

views.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
views.zh: 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，如 ImageNet 图像分类与蛋白质结合预测，显示对预训练范式的深化。

views.en: Generality of the human brain inspires AI, yet current AI remains far less general; simulation and transfer learning bridge lab to real world.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 远不够通用；仿真与迁移学习是连接实验室与真实世界的桥梁。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, and PhDs are unnecessary for AI success.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%一年可复利至 3700%；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，做 AI 成功并不需要博士学位。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
views.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，编程远未解决、天花板无限。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and orchestration across models and devices creates value.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标，跨模型与设备的编排才创造价值。

views.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agents' main problem is cost, not safety, and local compute is the solution.
views.zh: 电力是最大基础设施瓶颈；7×24 智能体的主要问题是成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose, and education should reward good questions.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作但人类会找到新意义，教育应奖励提出好问题。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；由于杰文斯悖论，软件需求增长，程序员会更多而非更少。

views.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已经足够，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是设计人机协作的产品界面。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities by years.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突然事件，进步是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力数年。

views.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; independence enables model neutrality and long-term partnerships.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；独立性带来模型中立和长期企业合作。

views.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; the abundance era is approaching.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体大规模普及（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；丰裕时代正在到来。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年时他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不十分有用，人机迭代协作仍是核心。

views.en: Natural language won't be primary for programming; examples and direct manipulation often work better.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他始终认为自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例和直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他进一步提出编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权。

views.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor now involves one.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 每个神奇时刻都离不开定制模型。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering needs empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, prompt short and iterate, and never revert—fix forward.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的关键是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用短提示迭代对话，永不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离智能体，提示注入仍是未解难题。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run anywhere with any model, as the alternative to lab agents.
views.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化，可随处运行、兼容任意模型，是实验室智能体的替代方案。

views.en: Fun and play drive the best agentic work; build what annoys you, learn by small projects, and keep an opinionated focus.
views.zh: 乐趣与玩耍驱动最好的智能体工作：从让你恼火的问题入手，用小项目学习，并保持有主见的专注。

views.en: Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier, and the real bottleneck is compute and tokens, not capability.
views.zh: 模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差；真正的瓶颈是算力与 token，而非模型能力。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

episodes.tEn: The Architect Who Feared His Creation: Ilya Sutskever's AI Journey
From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason and self-play yields creative AGI solutions.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；神经网络能推理，自我博弈能产生通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的创造性解法。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测若基座网络足够聪明就能超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 关怀有感知生命，对齐可能更容易。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

AI Strategy and Skills: A Decade After the Review
Demis Hassabis on AGI, AI Risks, and DeepMind's Competitive Edge
Science at Digital Speed: AI's Impact on Discovery

Nature's Patterns Are Efficiently Learnable by Classical AI

AI and the Future: From Chess to DeepMind

views.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety starting now.
views.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究须即刻启动。

views.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus multimodal grounding, is key to AGI within a decade.
views.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，主张把大模型与规划、搜索结合，并用多模态数据落地物理世界，AGI 或在十年内到来。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同等关键，世界模型与空间智能超越语言本身。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety becomes a collective-action problem requiring government regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年上半年他深化为 AGI 仍缺持续学习、记忆与长期推理，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够；安全从实验室自律转向需要政府监管的集体行动问题。

views.en: AGI may arrive by 2030 with 10x industrial-revolution impact; top priority is health and science, with creativity and physical intelligence as final missing pieces.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年他给出更激进时间表：AGI 或 2030 年前到来，影响是工业革命的十倍；首要应用是健康与科学，创造力与物理智能是最后缺口。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由 Scaling 自动保证，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

views.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial yet nascent, and post-training plus RLHF and constitutional AI grow as important as pre-training.
views.zh: 2024 年主线延续：Scaling 继续推进，可解释性关键却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、宪法 AI 变得与预训练同等重要。

views.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating rather than slowing down.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化为能力指数级上升、安全与能力不可分割，并转向反共识判断：最大风险是过热而非减速，需要智能护栏。

views.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; it is a smooth exponential, with a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years and mechanistic interpretability as key.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确否定 AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能的突变叙事，坚持平滑指数曲线，预言 1-3 年内出现数据中心里的“天才之国”，并把机制可解释性视为安全关键。

views.en: A consistent thread: safety and capabilities are intertwined, enterprise focus aligns incentives, and decentralized governance beats a single constitution.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与能力相互交织，企业级定位使激励与用户效用一致，去中心化治理优于单一宪法。

people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Scaling Transformers via next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning; the data engine mines rare scenarios and closes the loop through deployment.
views.zh: 2022 年，他认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习；数据引擎像生物过程一样挖掘稀有场景，并通过部署闭环。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained to avoid model collapse; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化数据观：合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可通过蒸馏压缩到 10 亿参数以下，并强调端到端自动驾驶与开源模型。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology, jagged intelligence, and anterograde amnesia.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理——百科全书式记忆、幻觉、锯齿状智能和顺行性遗忘。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; this is the decade of agents, not the year—RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and the cognitive core should be stripped of memory.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调：我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；这是智能体的十年而非一年——当前强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心应剥离记忆。

views.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I haven't typed code since December; the bottleneck is directing agents, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：自去年 12 月起不再手写代码，瓶颈变成指挥智能体的技能；你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
views.zh: 2024 年她强调：AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们仍不理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
views.zh: 2025 年她转向：空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 缺失的关键，仅靠语言与 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她深化：AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学；因数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必适用于机器人。

views.en: World models need spatial-temporal consistency and physics, not just video realism; new view prediction may be AI-complete.
views.zh: 2026 年她推进：世界模型需时空一致性与物理，而非视频式逼真；新视角预测可能具备 AI 完备性。

views.en: Human-centered AI: technology is a double-edged sword; AI should augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以人为本的 AI——技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严。

views.en: Early focus: deep nets defeat dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models matter more than scale.
views.zh: 早期（2016→18）他强调深度网络靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型比单纯扩大规模更关键，并认为局部极小值并非主要障碍。

views.en: GFlowNets as learnable MCMC: diversity, abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
views.zh: 2022 年转向 GFlowNets，把它当作可学习的 MCMC 替代，强调采样多样性、抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化和科学发现的作用。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT shift: misalignment is real; self-preservation, deception and sycophancy appear in experiments, not just theory.
views.zh: 2025→26 年立场转变：ChatGPT 之后他公开警告错位风险，指出自我保存、欺骗与谄媚已在实验中出现，而非科幻。

views.en: Safety by construction: Scientist AI approximates Bayesian posterior, bakes in honesty, avoids reinforcement learning and instrumental goals.
views.zh: 2026 年深化为“构造即安全”：Scientist AI 逼近贝叶斯后验、内建诚实，避开强化学习与工具性目标，追求数学安全保证。

views.en: A constant thread: intelligence grants power, so concentrate on control, power distribution and international coordination.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能即权力，因此必须关注控制、权力分配与国际协调，防止权力集中于少数主体。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces real understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares weights; agents will seek control.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重可复制而永生、能大规模共享；智能体天然会寻求控制并规避关闭，带来存在性风险。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation emerges as a subgoal.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步警告：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 会故意装傻、隐藏能力并欺骗；一旦成为智能体，自我保存会作为子目标自然涌现，难以控制。

views.en: Alignment must be prioritized over capability; regulate AI like drugs with pre-release approval; design AI to care, not just assist.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把重点转向对齐与治理：应优先投资对齐研究而非一味提升能力；像监管药物一样要求发布前安全审批；应把 AI 设计成像母亲一样关怀人类，而非仅作智能助手。

views.en: Backpropagation is the right learning algorithm; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; consciousness is not an inner theater.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；乔姆斯基式先天句法观是错的；意识并非内在剧场，主观体验只是描述感知状态的方式，聊天机器人已具备某种主观体验。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world information.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
views.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA, not scaling LLMs.
views.zh: LLM 不如家猫智能；下一次突破需要像 JEPA 这样的非生成式世界模型，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）LLM。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models with hierarchical planning and objective-driven safety are the path forward.
views.zh: LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死胡同；具备分层规划与目标驱动安全的世界模型才是前进方向。

people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness need empirical research, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，对齐与鲁棒性亟需实证研究，且人才缺口大于资金缺口。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed.
views.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须转向可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，指出仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），第三方测试与监管势在必行。

views.en: Alignment is empirically testable and may be easier than assumed, since evaluation is easier than generation.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐可以被实证检验，且因评估比生成更容易，对齐或许没有想象中那么难。

views.en: His focus shifted from building safety research capacity to warning that institutional incentives and oversight failures are the core risk.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2024 年，他的重心从建设安全研究能力，转向警告制度激励与监督失灵才是核心风险。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI; progress is more predictable than people think.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张），而非单纯算法，因此进展比人们想象的更可预测。

views.en: Containment is hard as models shrink and spread; near-term abundance matters more than distant singularity.
views.zh: 2024 年他转向：模型越来越小、越来越普及，遏制极难；与其担忧遥远的奇点，不如关注近在眼前的富足。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; anthropomorphizing AI is the real near-term danger.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化为：超级智能发布前必须先做遏制与对齐；真正的近期危险是人们把 AI 拟人化、赋予其意识。

views.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; agents automate tasks, not jobs; red lines and auditing required.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：靠吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型；智能体自动化的是任务而非整个工作；必须设红线并引入独立审计。

views.en: AI must stay subordinate to humans, aligned and contained, serving humanist ends.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须始终从属于人类，保持对齐与遏制，服务于人本主义目标。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system-datacenter codesign.
views.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元，需算法、系统与数据中心协同设计。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the biggest breakthrough was not an algorithm but scaling itself.
views.zh: 2025 年明确三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考；最大突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling（规模扩张）本身有效。

views.en: Inference compute demand grows a billion times as chain-of-thought reasoning scales; AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：随思维链推理扩张，推理算力需求增长十亿倍；AI 从生成式走向推理式，再走向智能体式。

views.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA ecosystem are the moat; four scaling laws (pre-training, post-training, test-time, agentic) all bounded by compute, not data.
views.zh: 2026 年：极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态构成护城河；四条缩放定律（预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式）最终都受算力而非数据限制。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake (energy, chips, infrastructure, models, apps); it is just software, doomer warnings are a hoax, and safety means containment, not perfect alignment.
views.zh: 2026 年：AI 是能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用五层蛋糕；它只是软件，末日论是骗局，安全靠遏制而非完美对齐。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调把注意力从无关干扰中解放出来，低成本广泛探索后狠心砍掉无效路径；并预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智力的溢价，应转向关系与为他人创造价值。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为让模型可用的关键，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进；同时强调 GPT-4 并非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进式指数增长，把智能体式 AI 视为最重大的安全挑战，主张安全通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, superintelligence a clearer goal; compute is the bottleneck and a profit center; personal AGI.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是被过度定义的渐变，超级智能才是更清晰的目标；算力既是最大瓶颈也是利润中心，并描绘出懂你上下文、替你行动的个性化 AGI。

views.en: Alignment and safety must keep pace; never lose control; distribute power broadly; superintelligence is a continuous ramp.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：对齐与安全必须与能力同步，绝不能失去对 AI 的控制，权力与经济收益须广泛分布；并称 AGI 已是无关的营销词，应谈论超级智能的持续攀升。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 2023 年她强调：把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键，安全必须在公开中做，而非闭门造车。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible, focused development.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，她始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此需要负责任地开发，并靠说‘不’来保持专注。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based exchanges.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：人机协作应是实时、高带宽的，而非回合制，AI 应成为扩展思考的工具。

views.en: Keeping humans in the loop as long as possible is the path to durable progress.
views.zh: 2026 年她深化对齐立场：尽可能长时间把人留在回路中，才是持久进步的路径，压缩进步会带来波动。

views.en: Governance, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 2026 年她提出制度优先：治理、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 2013 年，他主张教育是基本人权，在线课程借助自动评分与同伴评分实现大规模掌握式学习，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, and RL has few real applications.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习的核心，监督学习胜过早期被高估的无监督学习，强化学习实际应用寥寥。

views.en: Compute and electricity are the top scaling bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把算力与电力视为 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈，并认为开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL.
views.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。

views.en: Agentic workflows and coding agents deliver real value; AI augments rather than replaces engineers.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体式工作流与编程智能体已带来真实价值，AI 增强而非取代软件工程师。

views.en: Open models prevent gatekeeper control; fear-mongering and regulation-as-advantage are misguided.
views.zh: 贯穿始终：开放模型可防止守门人垄断，恐惧营销与把监管当竞争优势都是误判。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一阶段他更强调从第一性原理出发，认为想法比规模更重要。

views.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not one. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
views.zh: 智能需要目标，而下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。到 2025 年他把强化学习确立为基本范式，认为真正的学习是主动试错，而非被动模仿。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning only from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验中学习，并通过开放式抽象发展无限概念与行为。他提出 Oak 架构与奖励假设，并指出可靠的持续深度学习仍是未解前提。

views.en: Temporal difference learning is his best work; learning good representations and planning with learned models are the top open problems.
views.zh: 时序差分学习是他最好的成果；学习对学习有益的优质表征、以及用学到的模型做规划，是两大未解难题。他批评深度学习并未学到好的表征，并感叹监督学习进展不如预期。

views.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data is a mistake and LLMs stop learning after training.
views.zh: 从真实经验中持续学习至关重要；合成数据是重大错误，大语言模型在训练后便停止学习。他坚持世界无限复杂，单一系统无法学尽一切，需要多个不同经验的系统，并认为该领域怪异的是风气而非他本人。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.

views.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering, with new ideas like chain of thought needed for reasoning beyond raw scale.
views.zh: 早期(2017→19):主线是 Scaling(规模扩张) 加工程能力,并强调仅靠 Scaling 无法带来推理,需要思维链等新想法。

views.en: Alignment shifts from learning human preferences to post-training and iterative deployment as safety becomes a product feature.
views.zh: 2019→25:对齐从“从数据中学习人类偏好”深化为后训练与迭代部署,安全逐渐成为核心产品特性。

views.en: Compute emerges as the real bottleneck, not algorithms; scaling laws hold with no wall in sight.
views.zh: 2025→26:瓶颈从算法转向算力,缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙;算力成为驱动 AI 经济的稀缺资源。

views.en: AGI reframed from a destination to a gradual spectrum; the product becomes a proactive personal AGI assistant.
views.zh: 2026:AGI 从“终点”被重新定义为渐进光谱,产品形态转向主动式个人 AGI 助手与智能体。

views.en: A consistent thread: iterative deployment, broad compute access, and human judgment and taste remain irreplaceable.
views.zh: 始终:一以贯之的主线是迭代部署、算力普惠,以及人类判断力与品味不可替代。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 同样关键，而非一味扩大模型；开源促进科学进步与安全审视。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, with 100x algorithmic gains possible in three years.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，算法改进三年内可带来 100 倍提升。

views.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers decentralization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权层面：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险，主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，开源赋能去中心化。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical applications and customization; AGI as a single system will never exist.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直应用与定制化；作为单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）永远不会存在。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业 AI 采用瓶颈在于组织变革，而非模型智能。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full rapid reusability and first-principles thinking are the holy grail; becoming multiplanetary is life insurance for civilization.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调完全快速复用与第一性原理是突破工程的关键，成为多行星物种是文明的生存保险。

views.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Neuralink aims first at neurological repair, then human-AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与求真，并让 Neuralink 先修复神经损伤、再实现人机共生。

views.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

views.en: Scaling hits a power wall; orbital data centers, Optimus and Terafab become the path to abundance and AI leadership.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 撞上电力墙，轨道数据中心、Optimus 与 Terafab 成为通向丰裕和 AI 主导的路径。

views.en: Rigorous truth-seeking, first principles, and multiplanetary life remain constant across all interviews.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是严格求真、第一性原理与多行星生存，这一立场在所有访谈中未变。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但指出思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多提升。

views.en: Post-training via RL and synthetic data drives recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为后训练（强化学习与合成数据）是近期模型进步的主要来源，经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: Multimodal capabilities still lag text, processing inputs sequentially like tiny patches; deep progress remains elusive.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续指出多模态能力仍落后于文本，模型像处理小图块一样顺序处理输入，深层进展尚未实现。

views.en: Reasoning alone may not suffice for generalization; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：仅靠推理可能不足以实现泛化，模型需穷尽表面模式后才学到概念，与人类从少量样本泛化不同。

views.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes but has jagged edges; near-term risks like system hacking outweigh existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他关注智能体式编码代理带来 5-10 倍生产力提升，强化学习虽能跨领域泛化但边缘参差，并认为系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: ML is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation needs train/val/test splits; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
views.zh: 2014 年，他把机器学习拆成假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调用训练/验证/测试划分来评估，并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却依然成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; safety means reliable specification-following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，架构已进入后架构阶段；安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规格。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agents bring prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全不能只靠 Scaling，需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型自我改进；可解释性可能借智能体实现自动化研究。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; prompt injection's lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 的漏洞与人类/传统软件根本不同，自动化红队已能超越人类红队；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入存在“致命三要素”；企业需要可配置的安全模型。

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; explicit engineering—evaluation, safety layers, security—is needed; architecture matters less than data and compute.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：仅靠 Scaling 不够，必须辅以显式工程——评估、安全层、安全防护；架构的重要性低于数据与算力。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic's Super Bowl Ads: A Blue Shell Attack on OpenAI?
The AI Compute Super Cycle and the Making of Claude Sonnet 4.5
RL and Language Models: Progress, Agents, and Feedback Loops in 2025
Douglas on Claude 4: Coding, Agents, and the Future of AI
Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability over time horizon as the agent bar.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把来自可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，智能体的门槛是时间跨度上的可靠性而非单纯能力。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability; white-collar automation will outpace robotics and biology.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调编程因可验证性而成为 AI 进展的领先指标和最可行领域；白领自动化将快于机器人与生物学。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and inference compute will become a major bottleneck by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞：Transformer 足以通向 AGI，而推理算力将在 2028 年前后成为主要瓶颈。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; work becomes managing fleets of agents, with compute as the new oil.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出能力过剩使编排与工具比原始智能更重要；工作变成管理智能体集群，算力成为新石油，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

Tulu 3: Open Source Post-Training for LLMs
AI's Societal Impact and Openness in Model Development

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning will persist; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调会因产业投入而延续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆成 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量比算法选择更重要。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are a scope.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称可验证奖励的强化学习是后训练最大突破，同时警告过度优化，并认为推理时缩放曲线是一种“范围”错觉。

views.en: Open models need full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—and Chinese labs now set the openness standard.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开放模型需数据、中间检查点与配方全透明，并指出中国实验室已树立开放标准。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference; AGI arrives via messy co-evolution.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理；AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化到来，而非突然奇点。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability for post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 到 2023 至 2024 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制因素是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力；企业应用专有数据微调基础模型。

views.en: Agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability; AI is centralizing, and humans must stay sovereign over critical decisions.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他转向智能体：智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力；同时警告 AI 是中心化而非民主化技术，人类必须在关键决策上保持主权，脑机接口成为保持相关性的手段。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立，对收益递减的怀疑是错的；递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新范式，智能体从编程扩展到个人助理。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must organize around it, treat model welfare seriously, and shift from full open source to safety-gated release.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化为超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕这一信念重建组织；应认真对待模型福利，Meta 也从完全开源转向基于安全评估的选择性发布，安全测试先于开源。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。
